messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: ticket 9876 — elevated 95th pct latency on /v1/generate (us-west-2). severity: P2. paged to @mike (oncall).

mike (oncall): ack. I’m looking. First step: confirm scope and whether errors are customer-facing. @tara can you queue a short customer ack once we confirm?

tara (cs): on it. Draft below, tell me if you'd like tone changed.

tara (cs): ZENDESK MACRO DRAFT

Hi {{customer_name}},

Thanks for the report — we're investigating increased latency impacting token generation for requests routed to us-west-2. Our on-call engineer is actively troubleshooting and we’ll follow up within 15 minutes with next steps. If you have a recent request id, please paste it here.

Best,
Redwood Support

wanda (support): Also making an Intercom quick reply:

Intercom quick reply (copy):
Thanks for reporting — we’re investigating an issue affecting text generation latency in US-WEST-2. We’ve contacted the engineering team and will update within 15 minutes. If this is blocking production, reply “BLOCKER” and we’ll escalate.

alex (sre): quick triage log checklist for oncall:
1) confirm error rate vs latency: `curl -s "https://metrics.prod/redwood/api?query=request_latency_p95{route=\"/v1/generate\",region=\"us-west-2\"}"` 
2) check last deploy: `git rev-parse --short HEAD` on gateway
3) `kubectl get pods -n gateway -o wide` + `kubectl logs -n gateway <pod> | tail -n 200`
4) check model-serving nodes: `ssh model-node-1 'nvidia-smi -l 1'` and `ps aux | grep llm-serving`
5) look for recent autoscaler events: `kubectl describe hpa gateway` 

alex (sre): if you need a fast mitigation, temp route traffic to us-east-1 model pool and lift LB weight for 10m.

mike (oncall): doing steps 1-3 now. Found gateway CPU spike on two pods and a recent config rollout at 10:12 UTC.

ops-rotation-bot: note — mike has been on-call for 5h.

mike (oncall): I’m going to roll back the last gateway config (safe canary) and scale replicas to 8. Will report back in 6 minutes.

pat (product): if rollback works we should avoid changing model routing yet — prefer kernel rollback.

mike (oncall): rollback started — watching.

mike (oncall): rollback success. 95th latency trending down from 1.2s -> 260ms. marking partial mitigation.

tara (cs): customer ack updated — using macro above. Sending to affected large customers. Copy below of the status page draft and the public customer note.

tara (cs): STATUS PAGE DRAFT (public)
Component: API - Generation service (US-WEST-2)
Impact: Increased request latency causing slower text generation for a subset of requests.
Start: 2025-10-14T10:07:00Z
Current status: Partial mitigation — rolling back recent gateway config reduced latency for many customers. We continue to monitor and investigate root cause. Next update: in 30 minutes.

tara (cs): CUSTOMER-FACING EMAIL (short)
Subject: Update — Degraded latency for text generation in US-WEST-2
Body:
Hi {{contact_name}},

We deployed a fix that has reduced latency for many requests. Engineers are continuing to monitor and will provide a follow-up with root cause and timeline. If you continue to see degraded performance, please reply and include a request id if possible.

Thanks,
Redwood Support

wanda (support): small note for agents — if a customer reports token mismatch or truncated output add this snippet to the macro: `"If you saw truncated output please paste the request id and we will replay it internally."`

alex (sre): root-cause hypotheses: 1) gateway config exposed sync calls in hot path, 2) autoscaler mis-sampled metrics causing underprovisioning. Next: audit gateway config diff and autoscaler metrics for last 2 hours.

mike (oncall): handing off: I need a break. Handoff to @pat.

mike (oncall): Handoff summary pinned:
- Incident: elevated latency /v1/generate (US-WEST-2)
- Partial mitigation: rolled back gateway config + increased replicas, latency improved
- Next steps: audit config diff, confirm no regression, run canary test across 50 reqs in staging
- Slack thread: <this thread>
- Links: metrics dashboard, deployer logs, incident ticket 9876

pat (product): ack — taking over. I’ll run the config diff and follow up.

pat (product): INTERNAL EXEC SUMMARY (for ops leadership)
High-level: Partial service degradation for generation in US-WEST-2 due to a recent gateway config rollout. Mitigated by rollback and scaling. Impact: increased latency for subset of customers (affecting P50->P95). Action: full audit of gateway config rollout process and autoscaler sampling. ETA for RCA: 72 hours. Will provide interim updates every 6 hours.

tara (cs): sending final customer notes for those already notified with the rollback update.

wanda (support): quick agent cheat-sheet to paste into tickets:
1) Acknowledge + ETA: use macro
2) Collect: request id, region, timestamps
3) Apply workaround: route to another region if possible; offer retries
4) Escalate to SRE if status becomes BLOCKER or errors > X%

mike (oncall): :thumbsup: thanks team. Closing pager for now; monitoring for 1 hour then will close incident if stable.

ops-rotation-bot: mike removed from active pager at 2025-10-14T11:20:00Z. pat assigned.

pat (product):’ll open a postmortem template and assign owners for config rollout guardrails.

alex (sre): leaving a minimal remediation checklist for the postmortem:
- Add unit tests for gateway sync path
- Fix autoscaler metric sampling window
- Add alert that triggers before 95th latency > 800ms for 5m

tara (cs): thanks all — agents, please use the macros above and ping me if a customer escalates.

wanda (support): noted — saving macro to CS snippets folder.

pat (product): closing update; next status in 6h or on new findings.

mike (oncall): final: logs/links for handoff: dashboard: https://dash.redwood/9876  deploy logs: https://ci.redwood/build/54321

alex (sre): FYI — added a prom query to the dashboards for rolling-5m p95, should alert automatically.

mike (oncall): thread archived after next update.
